question: A project's knowledge base has grown to dozens of overlapping documents added by different people over time, and answer quality has fallen. What is the best way to improve it?
options: A) Add an instruction telling Claude to prefer whichever of the documents happens to be the longest.
B) Consolidate the material into a smaller set of current documents and remove the duplicates.
C) Add more documents covering the same topics so that the majority of the sources agree with one another.
D) Split the documents across several new projects so that each workspace holds only a handful of files.
correct_answers: B) Consolidate the material into a smaller set of current documents and remove the duplicates.
explanations: Length is no indicator of currency or correctness.
Correct. Curating down to current, non-overlapping sources removes the conflicts that degrade answers.
Adding more overlapping material makes the conflict worse, not better.
Scattering stale duplicates across workspaces spreads the problem instead of resolving it.
